_how_to_use: Copy this file to ~/.gopi/settings.json and replace the two PLACEHOLDER values. gopi ships NO credentials. Everything with a leading underscore is a comment (gopi ignores unknown keys); delete the underscore lines if you prefer a tidy file.
_required_1: Your OWN DeepSeek API key. Get one at https://platform.deepseek.com/ . gopi is bring-your-own-key: the account and the spend are yours, nothing is proxied.
_vision_optional: Image understanding. Same provider, same key.
_voice_optional: Speech-to-text is NOT DeepSeek. It is Volcengine (ByteDance) SAUC — a separate account, a separate app id and a separate access token, billed separately. Leave both keys below OUT entirely if you do not want voice input; gopi then reports the voice path as unconfigured instead of failing at startup. To enable it, uncomment (set) them and fill in your own values.
_paths_optional: Leave these two OUT to get the default layout: profile in ~/.gopi, scratch under <home>/workspace. Set them only when you want everything confined to ONE directory (a disposable test sandbox). Both must be ABSOLUTE paths that already exist or that gopi may create; a path pointing at a directory that is not there is a startup error, not a silent fallback. INSTALL.md §5 has the measured recipe.
_housekeeping: These keep a single-machine install quiet: task_sync=false means no ledger row is ever broadcast to another host, and an empty notify.cmd means no hook is spawned on a task event.
